## Renamed in 2026

Where the name this book teaches differs from an older name you may know. This book uses the 2026 name.

| Unit | 2026 name (taught here) | Older name |
|---|---|---|
| M1a | Circle Left/Right (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, Full) | Circle Left |
| M1b | Circle of 4 Left/Right (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, Full) | Circle Four Left |
| M1c | Single Circle Left/Right (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, Full) | Single Circle Left |
| M3a | Couples Promenade | Promenade |
| M4b | Allemande Left/Right | Allemande Left |
| M5 | Star Right/Left | Right Hand Star |
| M8 | Wheel Around / Reverse Wheel Ar. | Wheel Around |
| M11 | Swing | Swing Your Partner |
| M12a | Ladies Chain, (Ladies Chain 3/4) | Ladies Chain |
| M12b | Four Ladies Chain, (Chain 3/4) | Four Ladies Chain |
| M15a | Separate | Heads Separate |
| M15b | Separate Around 1 or 2 to a Line | Around One to a Line |
| M15c | Separate Around 1 or 2 into the middle | Around One and Come Into the Middle |
| M16 | Lead Right / Lead Left | Lead Right |
| M17 | Veer Left / Veer Right | Veer Left |
| M19b | (Named Dancers) Circulate | Circulate |
| M19c | All Eight Circulate | All 8 Circulate |
| M19d | Single File (Column) Circulate | Column Circulate |
| M19e | Box/Split Circulate | Box Circulate |
| M21 | Square Thru / Left Square Thru | Square Thru 4 |
| M25 | First Couple Go Left/Right, Next Couple Go Right/Left | First Couple Go Left, Next Couple Go Right |
| M31a | Alamo Style | Allemande Left in the Alamo Style |
| M32b | (Named Dancers) Trade | Boys Trade |
| M33 | Swing Thru / Left Swing Thru | Swing Thru |
| M34 | Run / Cross Run | Boys Run |
| M37 | Flutterwheel / Reverse Flutterwheel | Flutterwheel |
| M38 | Sweep a Quarter | Sweep a Quarter Right |
| M43a | Single Hinge | Hinge |
| M48 | Fold / Cross Fold | Boys Fold |
| M49a | Tag the Line (In / Out / Left / Right) | Tag the Line |
| M49b | Fraction (1/4, 1/2, 3/4) Tag | Half Tag |
| M50 | Recycle (from Waves only) | Recycle |
